_note: avenCITY citizens — v0.3. Every human has per-day needs that scale with their lifestyle LEVEL and grow over time. Zero wages exist: income is the heart drip + dividend streams. The founding grant is every player's first investment, received at spawn.

earmarked._note: Locked to exactly one founder share of a new hexagon unlock (10 shares x 30,000 = 300,000, see biomes.json). Ten new citizens = one new hex: population growth IS city growth.

free._note: Freely investable into sparks, domes, upgrades. Subject to demurrage like all held hearts — deploy it or watch it melt.

lifestyleLevels._note: Needs per game day BY LEVEL. Levels rise with tenure — the cost of living grows over time, so freedom must be re-earned at each stage (lifestyle inflation as mechanic). HOME slots reference LIVING-dome residency; rent is set by the dome.

levelUp.every: 1 game year (365 game days ≈ 15 real days)

unmetNeeds._note: Open question: reduce next day's heart minting per unmet need, floor 12/day. Not settled.

freedom.condition: dividend streams >= cost of living AT CURRENT LIFESTYLE LEVEL for 7 consecutive game days
freedom.note: Because needs grow with level, freedom is not a one-time badge — it must be held as life gets bigger.
freedom.cityScore: Freedom Rate: share of citizens currently free
